name: segmented-control
title: Segmented control
description: Two to five views or ranges of the same content (1D / 1W / 1M, List / Board): a radio group whose raised thumb slides to the choice.
whenToUse: Switching between two to five views or ranges of the same content.
A compact choice of two to five short options in a form (gender, level, frequency), as a field with its label, help and error.
notFor: Options people must read as sentences or that carry a description each (radio-group, radio-cards).

keyboard: Tab enters at the chosen segment
spec.motion: The thumb travels as matter (ui/lib/contour.ts), shaped by the look's mechanics (--m-morph-*): in soft its corner facing the new segment answers first, its leading edge rounds out a few pixels, the middle draws a slight neck and the corners round toward a capsule while it is stretched, then it gathers into its plain box. Nothing overshoots (critically damped, ~0.26 s, the far corner a little later). Metal, blueprint and mono stay rigid (it slides and stretches with straight edges); pop stretches most; glass is a little heavier; ink thins like a brush. The choice itself is made at once (state, colour, focus); only the decorative thumb settles. At rest: no clip and no frames. Reduced motion: it jumps.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Each segment shows its icon alone, as a square; the label stays its accessible name and tooltip.

props.name: style / ref
props.description: Visual root style; ref targets radiogroup element (composed with indicator measurement ref).

props.name: field / hideLabel / description / error / required / name
props.description: A form field: label above, help or error below, on whenever the label shows; hideLabel for a view switch or quick filter (the label stays the accessible name). name submits with a native form.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style address the visual root; classNames styles the documented parts. Internal measurement, keyboard and native ref wiring are preserved.

visualContract.refTarget: radiogroup element (composed with indicator measurement ref)

usage.name: As a form field
usage.code:
<SegmentedControl
  label="Gender"
  required
  fill
  value={gender}
  onValueChange={setGender}
  error={submitted && !gender ? "Choose one to continue." : undefined}
  options={[
    { value: "female", label: "Female" },
    { value: "male", label: "Male" },
    { value: "other", label: "Another" },
  ]}
/>
